Questionnaires and rating forms that I have translated, developed or published norms for. Each entry says whether the form can be downloaded here or where to obtain it.

These tools are intended for clinicians and researchers. A score or a completed chart supports a clinical assessment and does not replace one.

::: {#tools}
:::

## Using or adapting a tool

If you would like to use one of these in a study, need another format, or have found an error in a translation, please get in touch through my [NRU profile](https://nru.dk/index.php/about-us/staff-list/95-postdocs/288-kristian-reveles-jensen).
